klipper-helm bundles the Helm CLI; helm vendors x/crypto/ssh and x/net/html transitively but never invokes them; the `golang.org/x/net/html` package is NOT compiled into the `helm-set-status` binary. Vulnerable code not present.

Govulncheck determined that the vulnerable code isn't called
